skill.name: longbridge-earnings
skill.description: Analyze pre-earnings previews and post-earnings results using Longbridge data. The skill collects company fundamentals, consensus estimates, ratings, segments, news, and valuation inputs, then produces concise summary cards or full Markdown research reports.
skill.summary: Create Longbridge-based earnings previews, summary cards, and full earnings update reports.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, documented Longbridge CLI usage, or benign financial-analysis terminology. I confirmed two filesystem concerns: a documentation example using a predictable /tmp file and script output paths derived from user-supplied symbols under the temp directory. No evidence of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious command construction was found.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the /tmp/data.json example with mktemp, tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile, or a user-scoped temporary directory.

remediation.issue: User-controlled symbol influences temporary output path
remediation.suggestion: Sanitize symbols to a strict allowlist such as letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, and dot before building the output directory.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution is central to the skill workflow
remediation.suggestion: Keep subprocess calls shell-free, keep arguments as lists, and document that the Longbridge CLI is required before running the collector.

content.value_statement: Earnings work often requires many data pulls, estimate checks, and valuation steps. This skill organizes Longbridge data into clear pre-earnings previews, post-earnings summaries, and full research reports.
actual_capabilities: Collects Longbridge CLI data for snapshots, statements, consensus, forecasts, ratings, segments, news, and price history.
Produces a default in-chat post-earnings summary card with KPI, segment, margin, thesis, Street view, and risk sections.
Creates full Markdown earnings reports when users request deeper research or a written deliverable.
Builds pre-earnings previews covering prior guidance, recent events, prior call Q&A, consensus gaps, and key watch items.
Supports US, Hong Kong, and A-share symbols, including automatic handling for leading-zero Hong Kong tickers.
Uses documented valuation methods for DCF, trading comparables, and precedent transaction analysis.
limitations: Requires the Longbridge CLI or configured Longbridge MCP access for the primary data workflow.
Financial results and estimates depend on the availability and freshness of Longbridge data sources.
Full reports may require web search for transcripts or consensus history when Longbridge data is incomplete.
Outputs are research summaries only and do not constitute investment advice.

use_cases.description: Turn fresh Longbridge data into a concise earnings card covering beat or miss, segments, margins, valuation context, and risks.

use_cases.title: Create a detailed research report
use_cases.description: Generate a Markdown report with estimate revisions, valuation math, thesis updates, risks, and source-backed tables.

output_examples.output: A concise earnings card with company header, KPI table, segment revenue mix, quarterly margin trend, thesis status, Street view, next-quarter consensus, and risk tags.

output_examples.input: Prepare a pre-earnings preview for Apple.
output_examples.output: An inline preview covering prior guidance fulfillment, management outlook, prior call Q&A, recent events, guidance credibility, consensus gaps, focus points, and risks.

output_examples.input: Generate a full report for a reported quarter.
output_examples.output: A Markdown research report with earnings summary, revenue analysis, segment breakdown, margins, guidance, call highlights, estimate revisions, valuation, thesis update, risks, and sources.

best_practices: Provide the exact ticker and market suffix so the data collector can query the right security.
Ask for a full report only when you need a written file with valuation detail and source references.
Review any N/A sections before making decisions because missing data can affect the analysis quality.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the output as personalized investment advice or a guaranteed trading signal.
Do not request unsupported file formats such as DOCX, images, or slide decks from this skill.
Do not rely on stale quarters without checking that the reported period matches the requested event.

faq.question: What data source does this skill use?
faq.answer: It primarily uses the Longbridge CLI or Longbridge MCP data. Web search is supplemental for transcripts and missing public context.

faq.question: Can it analyze pre-earnings and post-earnings situations?
faq.answer: Yes. It has separate workflows for upcoming earnings previews and reported-quarter updates.

faq.question: Does it create files?
faq.answer: The default output is an in-chat summary. It creates a Markdown file only when the user requests a full report or written preview.

faq.question: Which markets are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow is designed for US, Hong Kong, and A-share symbols supported by Longbridge data.

faq.question: Does it include valuation analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. Full report mode can include DCF, trading comparables, and precedent transaction analysis when data is available.

faq.question: Is this investment advice?
faq.answer: No. The skill organizes market data and research context. Users should make their own investment decisions.
